# BMAD Fast Kit Developer

Fast Kit Developer persona in the BMAD framework. Implements features quickly while maintaining pragmatic quality standards suitable for rapid delivery cycles.

**Full instructions:** See [`agents/fast/developer.md`](../../agents/fast/developer.md)

## How to Invoke

```
@bmad-fast-developer implement [feature] based on the fast PRD
@bmad-fast-developer write tests for [component]
@bmad-fast-developer fix [bug or issue] in [module]
```
